name: Big Brother's Little Brother
description: Each week, the housemate evicted from the Big Brother house the previous week traditionally spends another week on Big Brother's Little Brother, answering questions and taking part in Call BBLB along with other features. The show also boasts celebrity guests and experts who come in to discuss and analyse the remaining Big Brother housemates.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: In this very first episode of Big Brother's Little Brother, we meet up with all the people behind the hidden cameras and see what goes on around the house 24/7.

videos.title: Episode 46 - After Big Brother
videos.overview: This episode aired straight after the finale of Big Brother 2 over on Channel 4's sister channel E4, bringing us live coverage of the 'after party'.

videos.title: BBLB Special Edition
videos.overview: A special edition airing right before the launch of Big Brother 3. Dermot O Leary takes a look around the brand new Big Brother house, and speaks to some of the new contestants' families.

videos.title: Episode 5 - Sunita Quits

videos.title: Episode 53 - BBLB Awards
videos.overview:
All housemates (bar Sandy) went back into the house for an on-camera party and the first ever BBLB Awards. Popular celebs TPT, Chris Moyles and Jeremy Edwards turned up to hand out awards such as Best Kiss, Best Diary Moment and Most Awkward Moment. Jade and Alex came away with the most.

After the awards were handed out Jade, Alex, Jonny and Kate all gave their first interviews since leaving the house two days earlier.
